text:
I was sitting in math class and feeling very hungry. Mrs. Green was talking about shapes, but I wasn't listening. My tummy made a loud noise like a drum rhythm.

"Is that a monster?" my friend Billy whispered to me.

"No, it's just my stomach," I whispered back.

Finally the bell rang and everyone scattered through the door. I ran to the cafeteria because I needed protein. I opened my lunchbox and saw a big blue vein in my cheese stick. It looked gross, though I ate it anyway. Then Billy screamed because he found a gummy worm in his sandwich. It looked like a tiny bungee cord.

"That is enough playing!" the lunch lady yelled at us.

We ate fast so we could go outside for recess. It was a pretty good day.

One day me and my dog Buster were exploring the woods. We were looking for pirate treasure by the old creek. Buster started running fast and I ran after him. He stopped at a big rock and started digging.

"What is it boy?" I asked him.

He kept digging and made a funny groaning noise. Then he pulled something out and I grabbed it. It was just an old shoe covered in mud. I felt anger but then I started laughing.

"Oh man, I thought it was gold!" I said.

Suddenly Buster froze and looked at the bushes. We heard a low moaning sound like a ghost. I turned around and realized it was just the wind. We left the shoe and walked home. My heavy breathing slowed down. Gravity pulled my tired legs but I felt certain we would find gold next time.

Yesterday was the hottest day ever at school. The sun scorched the playground and it felt like fire. We went outside for recess but everyone just stood still.

"I think the gravity is heavier today," said my friend Billy.

I nodded and wiped my sweaty face. "I am bearing the heat badly," I told him.

We looked at the scenery but the grass was brown. Suddenly a big wind swept across the yard. It felt so good and cleared the hot air away. We were so grateful for the cool breeze. Then the bell rang and we lost our recess time. We walked back inside slowly. I hope tomorrow is colder.

My friend Tommy came over for some company after school. We went straight to my room to play a wrestling game. I picked the giant guy who looked like a mountain. Tommy picked a skinny guy who was super fast.

"You're going down!" I grinned at him.

"No way, I practiced all week," Tommy said back.

We started mashing buttons and my guy was jumping everywhere. Suddenly my mom yelled from the balcony outside my window. We heard her say dinner was ready. I froze for a second. Tommy used that second to body slam me to the ground! My character fainted and lost all his health. I was so roasted by him.

"That wasn't fair!" I yelled, but we just laughed.

Next time I am not listening to anyone while playing. We had enough gaming anyway so we went to eat.

I rode my robot dog Sparky to the moon. We followed a long trail of space dust. Suddenly a green alien jumped out and grabbed me! He was moaning because his tummy hurt bad.

"Help me please!" the alien cried loudly.

I saw he was caught in a trap meant for bears. I used my laser eyes to break the trap. The alien fell to the ground and smiled. He was a space sailor lost in the stars.

"I am so grateful for your help," he said.

We saw a big spaceship approaching fast. It was his mom! I was happy to learn aliens have moms too. I promised not to do any swearing even though I was scared. Sparky barked and we flew home for dinner.

My dog Buster is the champion of chewing things. He chewed my mom's shoes and my dad's hat. One day we went exploring outside in the woods. The wind blew hard and Buster ran away fast.

"Buster! Come back here!" I yelled very loud.

He disappeared behind a big tree near the creek. I ran after him and I discovered a secret cave. It looked like a foreign land inside there. Buster was digging in the earth and he found a bone.

"Look what I found!" I said to Buster.

We cleared the dirt off a shiny rock too. It looked like a science experiment from school. A bird landed on a branch and watched our meeting. We walked home after fourteen minutes because it started raining. Buster thinks he owns the woods like a king's reign.

My nephew Max has the greatest superpower ever. He can talk to squirrels in the backyard. One day, a spaceship crashed right behind our neighbor’s fence. A green alien walked out and grinned at us. He was the same height as me.

"Do not fear," the alien said in a weird voice. "I am just looking for a snack."

Max saw a squirrel trying to gnaw on a sign. He sprinted over and threw a nut at the squirrel. The squirrel chattered and ran to the alien. The alien ate the nut and felt a cool breeze.

"This is good food," the alien said happily.

We were seeing a real alien eat a nut! I was certain nobody would believe us. Max just smiled and waved goodbye as the ship left.

We went to the spooky forest because we were brave. My dog Max is trained to find treasure. Suddenly we heard a loud groaning sound under the ground.

"What was that scary noise?" I screamed loudly.

Max started jumping and stamping his paws on the dirt. He found a rusty chain and we pulled it hard. A big door opened and we saw gold scattered everywhere. But then the floor sank and we fell down deep. I was hungry and I ate a crumb of my sandwich. Max crushed a bug and then we heard ringing. A ghost appeared and tried to knock us over!

"Run away fast Max!" I yelled at him.

We obtained a gold coin and climbed out quickly. We were safe but we never went back there again.

My cat Fluffy is really funny and likes to jump. Yesterday my mom sent me outside to play for an hour. I decided to do a science test with Fluffy in the garden. I wanted to see her jump high like she was on a bungee cord. Fluffy is big so her weight is heavy. She was moaning a little bit at me.

"Come on Fluffy, jump over this log!" I yelled.

She just looked at me like I was speaking a foreign language. Then I led her to the tree. Suddenly she started to sneeze very loud. Leaves were scattered everywhere on the ground. Dad was loading the car and he saw us.

"Did you receive a scratch?" he asked me.

"No, we are just playing," I said. Fluffy ran inside to sleep.

My dog Barnaby is a very naughty boy sometimes. One day he chewed up my dad’s newspaper. He left little white pieces all over the rug.

"Oh no!" I yelled. "Dad will be mad."

Barnaby looked sad and he was trembling a little bit. I wanted to wrap him in a blanket. But then I saw something else. He had a metal chain in his mouth! It was stuck on his collar.

I ran to get the scissors but they didn't work. I had to wait for my mom. She came home right on schedule.

"Don't worry," she said. "I guarantee we can fix it."

We pulled it straight and it popped off. Barnaby wagged his tail like a little lamb. He is a beautiful dog, even when he eats trash. I will always remember not to leave stuff on the floor. He was just waiting for a snack!

It was my birthday and my friends came over for a sleepover. We rode our bikes around the block very fast. The breeze felt nice on my face. Then we went inside to open presents. My friend Sam brought me a big box. I used scissors to cut the paper off. Inside was a squishy alien from earth! I tried to squeeze it really hard. Suddenly the alien disappeared from my hand. It fell on the floor and bounced high.

"Where did it go?" Sam asked me.

"I think it went under the couch!" I screamed.

We looked everywhere but we couldn't find it. Then my dog ran in with the alien in his mouth. We all laughed so much. It was the best birthday ever.

I was playing the greatest soccer game ever on Saturday. My team is called the Rockets and we were winning. But then my nephew came onto the field wearing a ghost costume. He just appeared out of nowhere and started running around! The referee blew his whistle very loud and stopped the game. Everyone was looking at the white sheet hanging off him.

"Get off the field right now!" I yelled with anger.

"But I want to play too," he said while groaning.

He tripped and landed right in a big mud puddle. Now his plain white costume had a giant brown stain. It looked like he was a dirty ghost from a foreign land. My coach laughed and walked him back to his mom. That is what happened at my big game.

I live in a big apartment near my school. One day I was doing my homework at the kitchen table. My dog Buster chewed on my pencil and it broke.

"Hey, stop that right now!" I called to him.

Buster ran away and hid under the sofa. I opened my backpack to get a new pencil. I found an old receipt and a sticky candy wrapper inside. Just then I heard a loud noise. Something crashed in the other room!

I ran to see what happened. Buster knocked over my mom's favorite vase. He looked trapped in the corner like a scared guard.

"Oh no, you are in big trouble," I said.

My mom came home and saw the mess. She pointed a finger at the broken pieces. I knew a grounding was beginning for poor Buster. He looked sad, but he ate his dinner anyway. It was beef that was stewed all day.

Me and my best friend Ben went exploring early in the morning. We were in the woods behind my house swinging sticks. We pretended the sticks were swords. Suddenly, we heard a weird noise. It sounded like singing but it was spooky. I was scared.

"Did you hear that?" Ben asked me.

"Yes, let's go check it out," I said.

We walked deeper into the dark trees. We found an old metal box on the ground. It looked like a science experiment gone wrong. I struck the lock with a rock. Inside, there was just a crumpled receipt and some rusty scissors. We were yearning for gold, but it was just trash!

Then a big dog barked loudly behind us. We sprinted all the way home very fast.

Max and I were playing knight in the backyard. We were running to the big hill behind my house. It looked like a giant mountain. We started climbing up the rocks very fast.

"Watch out for the dragon!" I yelled loudly.

Max nodded and held up his stick sword. We heard a loud thumping sound. It sounded like big feet stamping on the ground.

"I think the dragon is already here," said Max.

We neared the top of the hill carefully. There was no dragon though. It was just my dog Buster. He was jumping around.

"To be honest, I was scared," I said.

We laughed and then we ran back down. We found a cool rock and talked about the meaning of bravery. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods today. The weather was sunny and hot so we walked slow. We found a big hollow log near the creek.

"Look at that scary hole," I said to Buster.

Buster barked and treated the log like a monster. He tried to squeeze inside but he was too fat. I carefully looked in and saw something shiny. It looked like a lost jewel but it was just glass. Then a squirrel broke a stick and we jumped.

"Let's go home now," I whispered to Buster.

He agreed and acted like my guide back home. We were tired but happy after our meeting with the log. My mom brewed some tea and I thought about our adventure.

I was boating in space with my robot nephew named Beep. We saw a big gray building floating near the moon. Suddenly a green alien appeared on the ceiling of our ship! He looked very foreign and strange with three eyes. I was scared but Beep was brave. The alien was bearing a shiny red box.

"Do not fear me," the alien said loudly.

"We understand," said Beep. "What is growing in that box?"

The alien opened it and a blue flower was inside. We knew it was magic because it glowed. We landed on the dusty ground. I had a yearning to touch the flower. An army was approaching us but the flower made a shield. We were safe and happy.

I was walking near the mountain behind my house. I often go there to look for cool rocks. I spread out my blanket on the grass. Suddenly I saw a shiny blue thing. It looked like a big jewel. I picked it up but then a bird screeched loudly!

"Put that down right now!" my brother yelled. He ran over to the scene.

I was scared so I fell backward. I almost crushed the blue thing.

"To be honest, that is just an egg," he said.

We knew we had to be careful. We left it alone throughout the day. Later, my mom bought us ice cream because we were nice to nature. It was enough ice cream for everyone.

My sister Clara is always getting into big trouble. Last Saturday was her birthday and she wanted a princess party. Mom made a cake that looked like a pink castle. But then Clara twisted her ankle running in the yard. She fell down near the water fountain and started groaning.

"My leg hurts so bad!" she yelled loudly.

Mom ran over and called my dad to come help. Clara’s hair was trapped in the rose bush too. Dad had to use a comb to get it out. He turned to me and said, "This is a messy birthday."

It looked like gravity pulled her down really hard. Later she sat on the couch holding her stuffed lamb. She ate cake with ice on her foot. She was okay but the party was definitely over.

I was playing a really important basketball game today. My team is the Tigers and we were bearing down on the other team. We needed earning just two more points to win. I had the ball and I was moving fast.

"Pass it to me now!" screamed my friend Leo.

I saw a big guard in front of me. I did a cool spin move and touched the net. I shot the ball and it went right in! The buzzer screeched really loud. We won the game and everyone was stamping their feet.

"That was amazing!" called my coach, speaking very loudly.

I felt so pleased with myself. It was enough to make me happy all day. I ran to get my scissors to cut the net down. My day was complete.

Yesterday was a very weird day at school. We were playing kickball at recess and I obtained the big red ball. My neighbor Joey was on my team and he looked very pleased. I knew I had to kick it super hard. I ran up and kicked the ball and it flew high up.

"Wow, that is going to heaven!" yelled Joey.

But then the ball crashed right into Mrs. Miller’s window. The glass broke and everyone stopped moving. Mrs. Miller came outside and she looked mad. I thought I might have fainted right there.

"Who did this?" she asked us in a loud voice.

I guarantee I was scared, but I raised my hand. She actually smiled and said it was an accident. I was so happy I didn't get in trouble.

My dog Max loves exploring the woods behind our house. Yesterday we went outside together to find some cool bugs for science class. Max greeted a big squirrel and he barked very loud. The squirrel ran away fast but Max chased it.

"Max, stop!" I yelled, but he did not listen to me.

He ran into some tall bushes that were growing near a creek. Suddenly he cried because there was danger in the bushes. A stinging bee bit his nose! Max ran back to me and I saw a big red bump.

"Oh no, poor Max," I said and hugged him tight.

We escaped the woods and went home to my mom. She said we did not need a hospital but Max needed ice. I drew a picture of us and Max felt better soon.

Tim and I woke up early to explore the forest. We walked for a long time and followed a tiny path. Suddenly, the wind blew hard and it got very dark. We realized we were lost in the deep woods.

"Look at that cave!" I shouted to Tim.

We ran inside because big wolves were surrounding us. Tim was scared, but I started coaching him to be brave. We made a small fire and roasted marshmallows. I thought we were safe, but then we heard a growl. It was just a baby bear who wanted food. We gave him some treats and he was happy. We waited until morning and then ran all the way home. Mom stewed apples for breakfast and we felt safe again.

My neighbor Tim and I went to the scary woods. We wanted to find the secret gold. I brought a big stick and Tim brought his computer. He said it could measure how far we walked. Suddenly we heard a loud thumping sound behind a big tree.

"What is the meaning of that noise?" I asked.

Tim shook with fear and he dropped his bag.

"I think it is a bear!" Tim spoke quietly.

We saw a big shadow and we wanted to run. But then a small bunny hopped out. We laughed very hard. I tried to seize the bunny but it was too fast. We did not find gold but we had fun.

I thought the big green alien was friendly. He walked through the wall of my bedroom. He had four arms and blue slime on his face. I was trembling because he looked scary.

"I need some company," the alien said loudly.

My heart was pumping fast in my chest. I hid under my blankets and was clinging to my teddy bear. The alien zapped my toy robot with a laser. The robot started dancing and beeping.

"Do not be trapped in fear," the robot beeped.

I felt anger because he broke my favorite toy. I threw my pillow at the alien's big head. He laughed and then he flew out the window. It was the weirdest night ever.

My friends and I went into the dark woods. We were looking for the old pirate cave. We walked through the tall trees and it was scary. I held my stuffed lamb tight because I was nervous.

Then we saw a light inside a big rock.

"Are you certain we should go in?" asked Tim.

"Yes, we have to find the treasure," I said.

Inside the cave was very dark and wet. We lit our flashlights and saw something white. It looked like a ghost but it was just a sheet! A sailor left it there a long time ago. We found a box surrounding a big pile of gold coins. We paid for ice cream for everyone later!

Yesterday was the weirdest day at school ever. Mrs. Green said we were learning about animals, but then she scrambled onto her desk. She made a loud trumpet noise like an elephant and simply stared at us.

"Is she okay?" whispered Tommy to me.

"Maybe she has pneumonia or something," I whispered back.

Then Mrs. Green jumped down and grabbed some scissors. She cut a picture of a bear and threw it in the air. We went to recess and played a game about camping. Tommy pretended he roasted a marshmallow on a stick. Suddenly, we heard a moaning sound from the balcony above the playground. It was Mrs. Green again! She dropped a heavy weight on the ground.

"I brewed a magic potion!" she yelled down at us.

School is crazy sometimes, but at least lunch was pizza.

I walked into class and felt very scared. I remembered that my big math homework was due today. I looked in my backpack but I did not see it. Anger brewed in my tummy because I worked hard on it.

"Where is my homework?" I asked my friend Sam.

"Maybe you left it on the bus," said Sam.

I sat at my desk and stewed about it. It was important to complete this work for Mr. Jones. Then Mr. Jones came over to my desk smiling. He was bringing a paper from his big messy desk.

"You gave this to me yesterday," he said happily.

I was so happy I almost jumped up. I forgot that I already turned it in! Now I could go play kickball at recess.

My cousin had a birthday party on Saturday. We spent an hour pumping up lots of blue balloons. Then we started loading the snacks onto the big table. My little nephew was running around and jumping on the couch.

Suddenly, the lights went out and it was super dark!

"Is that a ghost?" I whispered to my best friend.

"No, it's just my dad!" shouted my cousin.

Her dad appeared with a big cake with candles on it. He was leading everyone in singing Happy Birthday really loud. We realized the lights were off for the candles. My cousin blew them all out in one big breath. We were very pleased to eat cake and roasted marshmallows. I was so happy I landed a huge piece with a flower.

I was sitting at the computer doing my science homework. My neighbor came over with his little nephew. They wanted to show me a picture from their camping trip. I dropped my juice box and it made a huge stain. It looked like a big purple blob on the plain rug.

"Oh no! My mom will start screaming!" I yelled.

My neighbor said, "Don't worry, we can clean it up."

We used a newspaper to soak up the mess. Then my mom appeared at the door. Her face turned red and a vein popped out. I did a quick search for cleaning tips. We scrubbed it hard and the spot went away. I was so happy I finished my homework.

I brought my new toy car to school today. It is the greatest car ever because it is bright red. But Mrs. Miller told me to put it away. I grumbled a little bit but I did it. At recess, I took it out to the slide. The slide is not straight. It is twisted like a snake. I wanted to see my car go down fast.

"Watch this!" I yelled to my friend Sam.

Sam looked over and smiled at me. I let go of the car. It zoomed down but then it flew off! It hit the ground hard. I ran over and looked at it. The wheel was crushed. I was so sad. That was enough playing for today. I put the broken car in my pocket.

I trained really hard for the big soccer game today. My legs were trembling a little bit because I was nervous. The other team looked huge and scary like giants. I looked up and saw a bird floating in the sky. Then the referee blew the whistle and the game started!

I ran fast and jumped over a muddy puddle. My friend Sam kicked the ball right to my foot. I saw the goal and knew everything depended on me. I kicked it super hard with my big toe.

"Did it go in?" Sam yelled loudly from behind me.

"Yes! We won!" I screamed and pointed a finger at the net.

We discovered that we were the best team in the building. Seeing the scoreboard change made me so happy. It was even more fun than boating or video games.

I had a really hard math test today. I struggled with the subtraction part because it seemed impossible. I kept chewing on my pencil and groaning quietly.

"Do you know the answer?" whispered my friend Sam.

"No, I think I did it wrong," I said back.

The teacher looked at us so I stopped talking fast. At recess we ran outside and played a camping game. We crawled under the slide like it was a tent. Sam threw a ball and pretending to be coaching a big team. Even though the test was bad, recess was super fun. Later the teacher explained the math again and I finally understood it. I won't get in trouble next time.

My dog Buster is weird and likes eating everything. One day we went camping in the woods surrounding our house. It was getting dark and my dad started a fire. We put marshmallows on sticks and got them all roasted and toasted. Suddenly Buster barked at a bush. It was a weird sounding noise.

"Is it a ghost?" I asked my dad.

"No, ghosts are not real," my dad spoke softly.

We looked closer and saw a tiny squirrel. It had a little vein on its ear. Buster just wanted some company. The squirrel ran away fast. I had to wrap my blanket around me because it was cold. The most important thing was that Buster was safe. We ate our snacks and went to sleep in the tent.

I had a big science test today and I was scared. My heart was beating really fast like a drum. I sat at my desk and pulled out my pencil. My teacher Mrs. Lee smiled at me.

"Just do your best," she said.

I looked at the paper and I saw thirteen questions. I didn't understand everything at first. But then I took a deep breath. I kept my hand steady and started writing. I looked out the window at the scenery for a minute. The trees were moving in the wind. I believed I could do it.

"I am finished!" I told Mrs. Lee.

She took my paper and gave me a star. I felt very happy.

Me and my best friend Sam went boating down the river. The weather was sunny and hot. We saw a big green meadow with cows roaming around. Sam chewed on some gum and looked at a map.

"We need to find the greatest treasure ever," Sam said.

We rowed hard and my arms hurt. I ate a protein bar for energy. Suddenly we saw a dark cave. A scary bear greeted us with a roar!

"We are going to be a failure!" I yelled.

But the bear just wanted to show us his painting on the wall. He brewed some tea for us. We didn't know bears could write or paint either! It was the best day. We left the cave happy.

The robot named Zog landed in my backyard early today. He was shiny and silver and he grew very tall. I followed him to the swings, but he just beeped. Suddenly, a weird green light appeared in the sky. It neared us very fast and I was scared of the danger.

"Look out for the alien ship!" I yelled loudly.

Zog started singing a funny song in a foreign language. The song sounded like beeps and boops. He shot a laser and the green ship flew away.

"Do you want some caffeine?" I asked the robot.

He shook his head and flew back to space. I hope he comes back tomorrow to play.

I was playing my favorite video game about space. My character appeared on a big red planet. I had to jump over a huge hole with low gravity. It was super hard and I kept falling in.

"Oh no, I lost again!" I yelled at the TV.

My brother walked through the door and grinned at me. He picked up the other controller to help. We fought the aliens surrounding us. Suddenly my character got hurt and started crawling. I was moaning because I had no health left.

"Use the magic water!" my brother shouted.

I found a glowing fountain and drank from it. I stopped groaning and jumped up high. We won the level and I was yearning to play the next one. It was the best game ever.

One day I was eating a plain sandwich in my backyard. Suddenly a green ship flew down from the sky. It landed on the grass and the door opened gradually. An alien walked out and he looked incredible! He had three eyes and purple skin.

"Hello earth boy," the alien greeted me.

"Are you real? That is impossible!" I screamed.

He held up a shiny ray gun and shot a tree. The leaves got scorched and smelled like stewed tomatoes. I was scared but then he smiled.

"I need to explain something," he said. "I am late for a meeting on Mars."

He gave me a robot dog and then he left. The robot dog can fly and do my homework. It was the best day ever.

I woke up early because my dog Barky licked my face. He slept on my bed all night keeping me warm. I looked outside and saw the sun coming up. It was going to be a good day for exploring.

"Come on Barky let’s go to the woods," I called.

We ran to the trees surrounding our backyard. The ground was wet but we didn't care. Suddenly I saw a small bunny near a bush. It looked scared although it didn't run away.

"Look at the baby rabbit," I whispered to Barky.

Barky greeted the bunny with a small woof. I wanted to squeeze it but I knew I shouldn't touch it. My mom always says wild animals are stronger than they look. We watched it hop away bringing a smile to my face. Then we went home to tell my mom and her daughter, my sister, about our adventure.

I walked into my room and turned on the big TV. The loading screen was super slow, but finally, the game started. My character was exploring a new planet called Super Earth. I discovered a giant cave, and it looked very dangerous inside. Suddenly, a huge monster that looked like a blue elephant ran out!

"Oh no, I am going to be crushed!" I yelled.

My friend Sam grabbed his controller and joined the game quickly. We shot lasers, but neither of us could hit it. The monster swept its big trunk and hit my guy. I lost almost all my health points. I feared we were going to lose the whole level.

"Aim for the red vein on its leg!" Sam shouted.

I grew brave and ran close to the beast approaching me. I blasted the leg, and we won the battle just in time.

I woke up early because the sun lit my room. My dog Buster wanted to go outside. We pushed the back door open and ran to the woods. The grass was growing very tall there.

Buster started to dig near a big oak tree. He found a strange wooden box! I opened it and discovered a shiny silver whistle inside.

"What is that?" asked my little sister, who followed us.

"It looks like a magic whistle," I said.

I blew the whistle and a blue bird flew down. It landed right on the box. The bird sang a happy song. It was a sign that we made a new friend. I gave the bird some seeds from my pocket. We were grateful for our fun adventure.

It was my birthday sleepover and my friends came over. We were jumping on my bed and making lots of noise. My mom came in and told us to be quiet.

"Stop stamping your feet!" she said. "Start cleaning this room right now."

We crawled under the bed to hide from her. It was like a secret cave with blankets hanging down. We fought over who would be the leader. Then we decided leading was too hard so we just played monsters.

"I will seize you!" yelled my friend Ben.

We crushed some chips on the floor by accident. The game was complete when my dad brought in pizza. He said he almost sold our pizza to the neighbors! We laughed and ate the whole thing.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods. We found a big stick for building a fort. Buster ran fast and his ears flew back. We stopped to eat lunch on a big rock.

"This is the best spot," I said to Buster.

He barked and wagged his tail really hard. We ate sandwiches and pretended we roasted marshmallows. The sun felt warm and spread all over us. Suddenly, a squirrel struck a pose on a branch nearby. Buster chased it but the squirrel won the race easily. By the time we got home, I was so tired. Mom had dinner ready and the carrots stewed in the pot. We toasted bread and ate it all up. Exploring makes you very hungry!

Me and my best friend Sam went to the old cave. It was dark and cold inside and I was feeling scared. Sam had a flashlight and he walked in first. We walked for a long time and saw thirteen big bats.

Suddenly a loud noise screeched from deep in the dark cave.

"What was that noise?" I asked Sam very quietly.

"I think it is a ghost sailor!" Sam whispered back.

We ran fast and I heard a ringing sound behind us. My foot got caught on a rusty metal chain on the ground. I fell down hard but kept clinging to my backpack. We scrambled out and did not stop running until we got home. We are never going back there again.

We were playing the best video game ever. It is called Super Mega Jump. My friend Sam was swinging his controller around like crazy.

"I am going to win this time!" yelled Sam.

"No way, I am jumping over the fire pit," I said.

My character did a cool bungee move and cleared the big wall. Sam’s guy fell in a hole and disappeared. But then the screen went black. The power went out for a whole hour!

We left the room and found a soccer ball outside. We tried to knock down some empty cans. It was actually really fun.

"Maybe we don't need the game," Sam said.

Then the lights came back on inside. We ran back inside super fast to finish the level.

One day my dog Spot and I went to the big mountain. We wanted to climb to the very top. The forest surrounding us was very green and quiet. Spot was running fast but I shouted, "Wait for me Spot!"

He stopped and wagged his tail at me. We walked up the path for a long time. Suddenly we heard a loud noise sounding like thunder. A big rock crashed down and crushed a small bush. I was scared but Spot was brave. I gave him a thumbs up.

"Good boy Spot," I said. He is in training to be a super dog. We ate our sandwiches and then we walked home happy.

I woke up late and ate my breakfast really fast. My mom made oatmeal but it looked brewed and gross. I ran to school and my backpack felt like a huge weight.

In math class, Mrs. Green gave us a worksheet. It looked impossible to finish before recess. I tried to squeeze my pencil hard to write faster.

"Did you remember your homework?" asked my friend Sam.

"Oh no! I threw it on my bed!" I said.

Then the bell rang for recess. We went outside and found a bird feather on the grass. We looked through the fence at the big kids playing baseball in their league. It was a good day even though I forgot my math. Finding a feather is lucky like finding a needle in a haystack.

Everyone got their bags ready for our big camping trip. We wanted to find the lost pirate treasure. My friend Tim wore his thick blue sweater. It was very cold and windy outside today. We hiked for an hour through the dark woods.

"Look at that big cave!" I shouted loudly.

We went inside, but unfortunately it was very scary. Suddenly we heard a loud stamping noise behind us. It sounded like a giant bear was angry. We started screaming and ran out fast.

"That was not on the schedule!" Tim said.

To be honest, we were too scared to go back. We did not find the treasure, but we were safe. Next time we will bring the colonel to help us!

It was my birthday and I woke up super early. I jumped out of bed and ran downstairs. My mom was cooking bacon and it smelled good. She searched for the big knife to cut the cake later. Suddenly the oven made a loud pop and smoke flew out! I was scared because the toast looked scorched and black.

"Oh no, I meant to watch it!" Mom yelled.

I laughed and opened the window. A cool breeze blew inside and the smoke went away. Then we heard a loud knock on the door. It was my best friend Sam for the party.

"Are you sleeping or eating?" Sam asked me.

We ate the bacon but we did not eat the burnt toast. It was the best birthday ever even with the smoke.
